propositions: The enrich drain gate check is O(ticket count) due to pending_enrichment walking every ticket directory and calling reduce_ticket three times per ticket, causing 490-740 ms latency on every write against a 20 ms budget

The gate's O(N) walk issues ~24,000 metadata syscalls per write, which contends with itself under concurrent writes causing multiplicative latency degradation when multiple agents write simultaneously
The 20 ms budget warning fires on 100% of writes in a 4,800+ ticket store, rendering the signal useless for detecting genuine queue saturation

The fix introduces an O(1) marker file .rebar/enrich-gate.json holding next eligibility time, allowing pending_enrichment to skip the full scan when the store is provably quiet, with automatic invalidation on any queue mutation via _append
